Hi Marta / AP team,

Thanks again for confirming the annual prepay commitment during last week's call. Attached is the proforma for tranche 1 so your AP team can kick off payment. To summarize the proposed invoicing cadence and items we need to collect from you: 

- Total committed annual amount: EUR 240,000 (prepaid).
- Proposed invoice tranches:
  1) Tranche 1: EUR 120,000 — invoice date on signing (attached proforma).
  2) Tranche 2: EUR 60,000 — scheduled 2027-06-01.
  3) Tranche 3: EUR 60,000 — scheduled 2027-10-01.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice.
- VAT handling: Redwood is registered in the EU. If Acme provides a valid EU VAT ID for the buying entity, we will issue the invoice net of VAT under the reverse-charge mechanism. If you do not have a VAT ID on file, VAT at the local rate will be applied.
- Required from Acme to proceed:
  * Purchase Order (PO) number to appear on each invoice.
  * EU VAT ID (if reverse-charge preferred).
  * Remit-to address for AP (billing@acme-corp.com or a different endpoint).

Attachment: 2027-02-01_Redwood_Proforma_Invoice_tranche1.pdf (proforma; non-final until we have PO & VAT info)

If you can confirm PO + VAT ID this week, we will send the final invoice and the signed MoP for your records. Once payment for tranche 1 posts, we'll ship reserved capacity for Q2 as discussed.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
